title: Without the both-direction filter on the bridge every customer shows the total
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Customer[Customer], "Balance", CALCULATE ( SUM ( Transactions[Amount] ), CROSSFILTER ( AccountCustomer[AccountID], Account[AccountID], ONEWAY ) ) )

source.quote: Each customer in this visual has the same balance as the total balance
source.supports: the page states that with single-direction relationships each customer shows 275

source.quote: CROSSFILTER will override any existing cross-filtering setting
source.supports: CROSSFILTER ONEWAY replaces the model's both-direction setting

derivation: With ONEWAY the Account relationship only filters from Account to AccountCustomer. A Customer filter reaches AccountCustomer and stops: Account and Transactions are unfiltered, so every customer gets 100 + 200 - 25 = 275.
